subject: Quick feedback on setup wording
text: Quick check because I am running a little late and my notes are messy. I need feedback on the setup instructions for the hall this afternoon. I thought you had said to place the welcome boards beside the east doors, but my colleague read that as the main entrance. That difference matters because one path is used by suppliers, and I do not want anyone blocking the unloading lane. Could you tell me which wording you meant? If it is safer to put the boards near the ticket desk instead, say so and I will move them before the doors open. I also need a yes or no on whether we still have one hour of access before doors open. The catering team emailed, but I could not match their arrival time to your message. I am not sure if the unclear instruction came from my side or from the schedule change. Sorry if this looks frantic, the program shifted and my phone keeps pinging. I just want the feedback before I commit the floor plan. If the original request was simply to make the space easy to find, then I will choose the clearest visible spot and stop asking. Either way, a short reply will calm things down. Do not worry about explaining fully unless you have two minutes. A single line will do: east doors, ticket desk, or choose for us. Thank you. I am holding the cart near storage now and can just adjust things right away.
